rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to the account, identified the correct order and item, checked variant availability, and executed the exchange using the gift card with the correct price difference ($7.99 refund). However, before performing the order-changing action, the policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation to proceed. The agent stated the intended change but did not ask for or receive explicit confirmation before calling the exchange tool; instead, they proceeded unilaterally. This violates the confirmation requirement. Additionally, the agent made a slightly speculative statement about shipping timing (“Once you send back the shirt, your new one will be on its way!”) not explicitly supported by the tools. Due to the missing pre-write confirmation, the conversation fails the pass bar.
